name: This_2
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm forward and outward with an open palm to point out or present something.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral rest posture. It raises its right arm forward, rotating the wrist to present an open palm facing upward and outward in a smooth, sweeping motion. The hand fingers spread slightly during the extension. After a brief pause, the robot lowers its arm back to the side, returning to its neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The robot extends its right arm forward and slightly to the right side. Ensure there is clear physical space in front and to the right of the robot's torso.
